covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SXE-53, authored by muse-b3 as author of record (CB-0828; registrar-only conversion of the check file's content) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SXE-53.md (fixer muse-b2), build e4cf838f9 on branch sx/heavy-engines (parent exactly 68f2886e5, the SXE-52 head; fire-time base-blob guard clean; all 57 pushed blobs byte-identical staged to landed; post-push neighbour re-read confirms SXE-51's rpc.js and SXE-52's five entries/kernels intact at the new head). The build carries ten catalogue rows as FOURTEEN engine entries on the SXE-52 entries/ pattern (entry server/lib/conkay/engines/entries/<id>.js · kernel server/lib/conkay/engines/kernels/kernel-<id>.py · suite · doc docs/conkay/engines/<id>.md): chrono (SXE-14, PyChrono 9.0.0, BSD-3-Clause) · pinocchio (SXE-14, 3.3.0, BSD-2-Clause) · openmodelica (SXE-15, 1.25.0, OSMC-PL/GPL-3.0 process, MSL BSD-3) · ngspice (SXE-16, 44, BSD-3-Clause modified) · curaengine (SXE-38, 5.9.0, AGPL-3.0-only) · prusaslicer (SXE-38, 2.9.0, AGPL-3.0-only) · openradioss (SXE-13, 2025.09, AGPL-3.0-only) · elmer (SXE-10, 9.0, GPL-2.0/LGPL-2.1 process) · su2 (SXE-12, 8.3.0, LGPL-2.1-only) · code-aster (SXE-08, 17.4.0, GPL-3.0-only) · control (SXE-20, python-control 0.10.1, BSD-3; slycot GPL-2 child) · casadi (SXE-20, 3.7.0, LGPL-3.0-only) · acados (SXE-20, 0.5.0, BSD-2-Clause) · pybamm (SXE-25, 25.1.0, BSD-3-Clause). Scope is the CI-only scope of the founder F1 ruling (2026-11-18): nothing is installed on any host; on prod these engines answer NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:<id> until a compute host exists. F7: the three AGPL engines are declared unmodified: true and run process-only, unmodified — the SXE-00 manifest validator enforces both. F8: every lane is workflow_dispatch only. Provenance: INDEPENDENT — every health reference is a closed form, a published tutorial value (SU2 CL), the distribution's own shipped QA/test case (OpenRadioss, Elmer), or a lane-recorded stored reference (slicers, Elmer value leg), each named in its engine doc. NAMED SUBSTITUTIONS / HONEST LIMITS, carried exactly as filed: (i) SXE-16's row names ngspice + Xyce — this build registers ngspice only; Xyce is a separate future engine (its GPL-3 process shape recorded in the ngspice doc); the row is not silently collapsed. (ii) Code_Aster health: the plan's SSLV-family case is reduced to the one-HEXA8 tension member with an exact closed form — the same substitution shape the office accepted for SXE-07/CalculiX. (iii) Slicers + Elmer value references are environment data by design: kernels serve the measured value and enforce the band only when the lane-recorded reference env is set; no reference number is invented in code; the first lane dispatch records each reference. (iv) SU2's SXE-39 dependency is the MPI lane: parallel SU2 builds ride SXE-52's mpi entry; this entry registers the serial lane and says so. (v) Version pins are the manifest pins of record; each CI lane installs exactly its pin and fails if it cannot — the lane's first manual dispatch is each pin's verification route; OpenModelica's lane installs via the release's apt channel and fails loudly rather than floating if the pinned 1.25.0 package is unavailable. NOT CLAIMED: the H2 install legs of SXE-53's catalogue rows — the deferred-open remainder, not built here; the fourteen CI lane files (.github/workflows/conkay-engine-<id>.yml) are desk git-route deliverables staged at stage-sxe53/workflows/ (CB-0854), NOT landed with this build; Xyce. Tier 1 is PROPOSED in the check file — assigned at acceptance by the reviewer. steps: engineListReport carries fourteen new rows (chrono, pinocchio, openmodelica, ngspice, curaengine, prusaslicer, openradioss, elmer, su2, code-aster, control, casadi, acados, pybamm), each with its pinned version + licence of record; the three AGPL entries (openradioss, curaengine, prusaslicer) declare unmodified: true and linkMode process, enforced by the manifest validator.
With no host provisioned, every one of the fourteen answers NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:<id> — the F1 prod posture.

Kernel honesty legs (SXE-00 shape) hold per engine: schema/cap refusals before spawn (exit 2); provisioning defects named, never fabricated (exit 3 — e.g. 'python-control import failed', 'ngspice executable not found on PATH'); garbled/forged output rejected (exit 5); engine failure (exit 6); converged=false maps to NOT_COMPUTED engine_not_converged. All fourteen kernels byte-compile.

Closed-form health anchors in the CI lanes: chrono pendulum period vs closed form (amplitude-corrected), band 2% · pinocchio RNEA at rest vs m*g*L*sin(angle), band 1e-6 (kernel self-refuses on mismatch) · openmodelica driven inertia J*der(w)=T with w(1)=1 exact, band 1e-3 · ngspice RC step v(tau) vs V*(1-e^-1), band 2% · code-aster one-HEXA8 tension vs delta=PL/(EA) exact, band 1e-3 (the named SSLV reduction) · control LQR double integrator vs analytic Riccati K=[1, sqrt(3)] for Q=I, R=1, band 1e-6 · casadi projection NLP vs closed-form projection, band 1e-6 · acados finite-horizon LQR OCP, u0 vs in-kernel Riccati recursion band 5% with |p(tf)| < 0.1.

Published / distribution anchors: su2 inv_NACA0012 (Mach 0.8, AoA 1.25) CL vs published 0.287, band ±0.05 (serial lane; parallel rides SXE-52's mpi entry) · openradioss distribution's own shipped QA bar-impact deck, energy drift band 10% · elmer shipped mgdyn_steady_coil completes with finite saved data, value band 5% vs the lane-recorded reference.

Stored-reference legs: curaengine + prusaslicer 20 mm cube slices within ±10% of the lane-recorded stored references (recorded by each lane's first verified run; no reference number exists in code) · pybamm SPM 1C discharge (Chen2020) completes, capacity within 8% of the parameter set's own nominal, read from the parameter values, never hard-coded. A skipped test fails its lane (manual dispatch per F8).
